text_block_list.text:
Having conquered the vast sea of the 
Hopeful Stakes, Gold Ship found herself at 
a loss for a goal. Is there nowhere left 
for her fighting spirit to go?

No, wait, there is. Becoming a master 
craftsman of green bento dividers and 
supporting Japan's food culture! ...Are 
you really sure you want that, Gold Ship!?

Volume Two of the Secret Tome appeared 
before her. Learning that the path to Eden 
continued even further, her fighting 
spirit blazed for the Classic races.
